title: Design mockup
description: Product frames on a world stage, with a user path compiled by ScreenFlow. Comments stay in host Design Mode.
antiPatterns: ArtboardStage as the canvas root (that is a flow fit-all card)
stacking phone and desktop frames as a document inside Frame
hand-rolled annotation chrome; use host Design Mode pins
DocsShell or document font on a mockup
inventing methodology tabs for a mockup
hand-drawn SVG noodles or Connector primitives
using WorkflowDiagram to draw a screen path
treating three device widths of one surface as the path
edges between width variants of the same step
parking a note or kit in the 32px band above the start Artboard caption
agentPrompt: WorldStage root. Artboard id + preset + Layer x/y from one frame-box table. ScreenFlow spec for the user path; validateScreenFlowPaint({ spec, frames }) and apply only the first supportedFix. If the same diagnostic repeats two rounds, stop and report. Gutters ≥120px, prefer 140. Leave the band above the start caption empty (host paints spec.title there and a role key). Device variants do not get edges. UI font. Do not wrap in Frame. Do not fake comment pins. Do not set via, labelAt, fromSide, or edge.color.
